analysis_spec.cross_validation: leave one of four adjacent latent-time pairs out; train on all spatial tokens from the other three pairs
analysis_spec.direct_energy: mean absolute value of the 64 signed-difference features
analysis_spec.feature: signed adjacent-time latent difference; flattened 2x2 spatial block across 16 channels into 64 values
analysis_spec.primary_target: fractional red-proxy XOR occupancy in corresponding 16x16 RGB patches
analysis_spec.readout: train-fold standardized ridge regression, intercept, alpha=1.0
analysis_spec.sample_count_boundary: one generated clip; four correlated transition pairs; denoising snapshots are repeated views of the same generation
analysis_spec.secondary_target: mean absolute RGB difference per pixel in corresponding 16x16 patches
analysis_spec.spatial_baseline: training-pair mean red-XOR occupancy at each spatial token

limitations: Single generated clip, prompt, and seed; four transition folds are correlated and are not independent samples.
The red RGB threshold and RGB differences are same-output proxies, not human labels or ground truth.
Red-mask XOR can include threshold shimmer; RGB change also includes lighting and appearance changes.
The nominal latent/RGB anchor mapping does not define exact VAE temporal receptive fields.
This readout does not establish object understanding, forecasting, geometry/contact, causal control, policy efficacy, generalization, or M1/M2/M3 completion.
